recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source change is needed for FHIR-16994 unless a future work group decision changes the current ElementDefinition.short profile guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-16994 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request for ElementDefinition.short. It asked to remove the Comments wording, "May change the term to provide language more appropriate to the context of the profile or to reflect slicing," because it read like an internal reminder that should be resolved before publication.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 14313. The corresponding git-svn commit 6c966da0773fee83a59bb664bc42d5f91f9cc661, whose message includes GF#16994, changed source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml and replaced the obsolete ElementDefinition.short Comments cell with the current warning about the risk of changing short definitions in profiles.
additional_context: ElementDefinition remains in current build scope: source/fhir.ini lists it as an active datatype, maps elementdefinition to the elementdefinition page, and marks ElementDefinition normative. The obsolete phrase is absent from active current source and appears only in tools/history release2/release3 snapshots for older releases. The same historical SVN revision also mentions FHIR-16862 and FHIR-16011, but those are separate ElementDefinition changes and were not decided here.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The current active ElementDefinition.short row no longer contains the FHIR-16994 reminder text, and the remaining Comments text is substantive implementer guidance rather than the removed reminder.
